description: Get a link to a scene the user owns, optionally changing who can open it. Use it when the user wants to send or post a scene, or change it to public, unlisted or private; to cut off a link use revoke_share_link; for website code use get_embed_code. Parameters: `visibility` 'unlisted' (anyone with the link; the default for new scenes), 'public' (also listed) or 'private' (opens only with a secret token); omit it to keep the current setting. `new_token` gives a revocable link without making the scene private. `autoplay_tour` starts the default camera tour on open. Side effects: changes the scene's visibility when `visibility` is given, and every token call creates another token. The token is shown only once; keep `shareId` to revoke it. Links never expire on their own. Requires sign-in (connector sign-in, or VERSE_API_KEY for the local server).

autoplay_tour.description: Open the link playing the scene's camera path (see list_camera_paths).

new_token.description: Mint a fresh private share token even if the scene is not private (e.g. to hand out revocable links).

scene.description: Scene id (e.g. palm-villa-0a1b2c3d4e5f), the job id returned by upload_scene, or a Verse share link.

visibility.description: Set the scene's visibility first. Omit to keep it as is.

name: create_share_link

shareId.description: Id of the minted token, for revoke_share_link.

visibility.description: The scene's visibility after the call.

title: Create a share link (set visibility)
